verdict.rationale: Together documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that only needs a new API key and base URL, plus agent-loop function-calling guides. It also has a first-party agent-skills page with 12 skills and a docs MCP server that make coding agents Together-aware. However, the evidence shows no named, first-party guides for plugging Together in as the model backend of specific coding agents or agent frameworks; compatibility is implied rather than shown per tool. Missing for 10: framework-specific integration guides (e.g. for named agent frameworks or SDKs), guides for configuring coding agents to use Together models as their LLM backend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
